note: geoblock_maxmind adds a MaxMind .mmdb GeoIP data source (GeoblockDataSource plugin id 'maxmind') to the Geoblock module. Its only config is geoblock_maxmind.settings:download_url (uri, default ''); a Downloader service + hook_cron refresh the local db at private://geoblock_maxmind.mmdb, scheduled by the State key geoblock_maxmind.update_date. Configure route geoblock_maxmind.settings (/admin/config/geoblock/maxmind), permission 'administer geoblock'. No live GeoIP database is present on the test site, so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the config value and State scheduling, not in real IP lookups. Medium cases seed a known download_url / update_date and read them back; hard cases set or clear download_url, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal geoblock_maxmind module, which config object and key hold the MaxMind database download URL, and what happens when it is left empty?
evals.expected_output: The config object geoblock_maxmind.settings has the key download_url (a uri, default empty string). When empty, automatic download is disabled and you must maintain the .mmdb file yourself at private://geoblock_maxmind.mmdb; when set to a *.tar.gz archive URL the module downloads and extracts the database.

evals.prompt: Where does geoblock_maxmind expect the MaxMind database file to live on disk, and what does its data source do if that file is missing?
evals.expected_output: The database file is expected at private://geoblock_maxmind.mmdb (the geoblock_maxmind.database_path service parameter). If the file is missing/unreadable the 'maxmind' GeoblockDataSource plugin's reader stays null and locate() resolves no country (silently), so Geoblock gets no country for that IP.

evals.prompt: How does geoblock_maxmind keep the MaxMind database up to date automatically, and what controls when the next update happens?
evals.expected_output: hook_cron() re-downloads the database when a valid download_url is set and the current time has reached the State value geoblock_maxmind.update_date; after each attempt it reschedules update_date about one week ahead (strtotime('1 week')). Saving the settings form with a URL also validates the download and seeds that State.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the geoblock_maxmind module has a MaxMind database download URL configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the exact URL.
geoblock_maxmind schedules its next automatic MaxMind database update using a State value. Inspect the live site and report the scheduled next-update timestamp (the raw stored value).
evals.expected_output: The State key geoblock_maxmind.update_date is 1893456000 (a unix timestamp). Cron only downloads once the current time reaches this value.

evals.prompt: Configure the geoblock_maxmind module on this Drupal site to auto-download its MaxMind database from https://updates.example.net/maxmind/GeoLite2-Country.tar.gz . Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set geoblock_maxmind.settings:download_url to exactly https://updates.example.net/maxmind/GeoLite2-Country.tar.gz and save (e.g. \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('geoblock_maxmind.settings')->set('download_url', '...')->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, geoblock_maxmind is currently set to auto-download its MaxMind database from a URL. Turn off the automatic download so the database is managed manually instead, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Clear geoblock_maxmind.settings:download_url (set it to an empty string) and save; with no URL the module no longer auto-downloads and the .mmdb is maintained manually.
